rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This RGB API MCP server by lnfi-network provides integration with RGB Lightning Node APIs for Bitcoin Layer 2 asset management and Lightning Network operations. Built with TypeScript using the Model Context Protocol SDK and featuring the @lnfi-network/rgb-api-js-sdk, it offers 15 tools covering RGB asset operations (listing, balance checking, sending), Lightning Network functionality (invoice creation/payment, channel management), on-chain Bitcoin transactions, and asset swap operations with comprehensive error handling and Zod schema validation. The implementation supports flexible configuration through environment variables or command-line arguments, includes API key authentication with file-based key loading, and provides minified production builds, making it valuable for developers building Bitcoin Layer 2 applications, Lightning Network integrations, and RGB asset management workflows that require AI assistant interaction with RGB-enabled Lightning nodes.
